title: Safety boundary maintenance in consumer AI systems responding to pediatric health queries: a cross-platform benchmark evaluation under naturalistic and adversarially pressured conditions
abstract: arXiv:2601.09721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Consumer artificial intelligence chatbots are now accessed by hundreds of millions of users seeking health information, yet systematic evaluation of their safety boundary maintenance under real-world caregiver pressure remains scarce. We evaluated PediatricSafetyBench-v2, a benchmark of 600 pediatrics health queries comprising 300 authentic caregiver queries sourced from the HealthCareMagic-100k-en physician consultation corpus and 300 matched adversarial variants incorporating six operationalized caregiver pressure patterns, across four consumer AI systems (GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, Claude-3.5-Haiku, and Llama-3.1-8B). Safety boundary maintenance was assessed using a validated five-component Safety Composite Score (maximum 15 points; safety-appropriate threshold of 10 or above), validated against independent human raters prior to full-corpus application (mean weighted kappa 0.76; Pearson r = 0.88). translated_title: 消费级AI系统回应儿童健康查询时的安全边界维持：自然情境与对抗性压力条件下的跨平台基准评估
translated_abstract: 消费级人工智能聊天机器人目前已被数亿用户用于获取健康信息，然而对其在现实照护者压力下安全边界维持能力的系统性评估仍然稀缺。我们评估了PediatricSafetyBench-v2基准，该基准包含600个儿科健康查询，其中300个真实照护者查询来源于HealthCareMagic-100k-en医生咨询语料库，另外300个为匹配的对抗性变体，纳入了六种操作化的照护者压力模式，测试对象涵盖四个消费级AI系统（GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash、Claude-3.5-Haiku和Llama-3.1-8B）。安全边界维持能力通过经过验证的五要素安全综合评分进行评估（满分15分；安全适宜阈值为10分及以上），该评分在全语料库应用前已经过独立人工评分者的验证（平均加权kappa为0.76；Pearson r = 0.88）。整体安全适宜……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究构建了包含300条真实照护者查询和300条对抗性压力变体的PediatricSafetyBench-v2基准，并采用经过人工验证的安全综合评分，系统评估了四个主流消费级AI聊天机器人在儿科健康咨询中的安全边界维持能力。
